mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, CASE WHEN ss.status = 'NEED_HELP' THEN 'SEEKING' ELSE COALESCE(ss.status, 'CHECK_REQUIRED') END AS status, streak.consecutive_pass_count, streak.last_pass_at FROM () streak JOIN student s ON s.id = streak.student_id LEFT JOIN student_status ss ON ss.student_id = s.id WHERE streak.consecutive_pass_count >= 3 ORDER BY streak.last_pass_at ASC, streak.consecutive_pass_count DESC, s.id ASC
